technique_name: Write an article about how online learning is becoming more popular.
description: In recent years, online learning has become an increasingly popular mode of education. With the growing availability of high-speed internet, more people than ever are taking advantage of the convenience and flexibility that online classes and programs offer. Distance learning is also a great option for adult learners to maintain their job while still pursuing a degree or certification.
